teaser.en: The garden *tungudza* has a wild cousin, *mtungudza koma*, that is used in medicine instead of the cooking pot.
teaser.sw: *Tungudza* wa bustanini ana jamaa wa porini, *mtungudza koma*, ambaye hutumika kama dawa badala ya kuingia chunguni.

summary.en: *Tungudza* is the African eggplant or garden egg, a bushy plant with small round fruits. Both the fruit and the leaves are cooked.
summary.sw: *Tungudza* ni ngogwe, mmea wenye matawi mengi na matunda madogo ya mviringo. Tunda na majani yake hupikwa.

about.en: *Tungudza* is a bushy plant with broad leaves and small star-shaped flowers, white or pale purple. The fruits are small and round, like little eggs, and may be green, white, yellow or orange-red.
about.sw: *Tungudza* ni mmea wenye matawi mengi, majani mapana na maua madogo yenye umbo la nyota, meupe au ya zambarau hafifu. Matunda yake ni madogo na ya mviringo, kama mayai madogo, na yanaweza kuwa ya kijani, meupe, ya manjano au mekundu ya chungwa.

where.en: It is grown in home gardens on the south coast.
where.sw: Hupandwa katika bustani za nyumbani pwani ya kusini.

uses.en: Both the fruit and the leaves are cooked.

names.en: The fruit is *tungudza* and the plant *mtungudza*. The wild *Solanum incanum* is called *mtungudza koma*, the wild *tungudza*, and is used in medicine. Swahili calls the garden kind *ngogwe* or *tungudza*. In English it is African eggplant or garden egg. The name covers two species, *Solanum macrocarpon* and *S. aethiopicum*.
names.sw: Tunda huitwa *tungudza* na mmea *mtungudza*. Mmea wa porini *Solanum incanum* huitwa *mtungudza koma*, yaani *tungudza* wa porini, na hutumika kama dawa. Kwa Kiswahili aina ya bustanini huitwa *ngogwe* au *tungudza*. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *African eggplant* au *garden egg*. Jina hili linahusu spishi mbili, *Solanum macrocarpon* na *S. aethiopicum*.

reason.en: Its wild relative, used in medicine
reason.sw: Jamaa wake wa porini, anayetumika kama dawa
Jenasi moja; mboga nyingine ya majani
